questions.q: Why did the swallows pull the ship over to an island?
choices: They saw a storm coming over the sea
They wanted to visit the canaries there
They were tired and needed to rest
The pirates had blocked the way home
questions.evidence: they would have to take a rest soon

questions.q: Why did the Doctor want to get off the ship onto the island?
choices: To find tall trees to make a new mast for the ship
To look for water, because none was left to drink
To hunt for the pirates who had chased them across the sea
To pick fruit for the animals
questions.evidence: because there was none left to drink on his ship

questions.q: How did the big black rat act when he came to speak to the Doctor?
choices: Nervous and shy, coughing and watching the dog
Bold and proud, shouting so all could hear him
Angry and rude, telling the Doctor to go away
Sleepy and slow, yawning between every word
questions.evidence: after he had coughed nervously two or three times

questions.q: What did the rat warn the Doctor about?
choices: The pirates were hiding on the far side of the island
The spring water on this island was not safe to drink
A great storm would come in from the sea before morning
The ship's boards were rotten and it would sink

questions.q: How do the rats know when a ship is going to sink?
choices: They hear the old boards creak loudly in the night
They can smell the sea-water seeping in down below
The tips of their tails get a tingly feeling
Their whiskers droop and curl
questions.evidence: The tips of our tails get that tingly feeling

questions.q: The Doctor called the rat "very considerate" for coming to warn him. What does "considerate" mean?
choices: Very clever and quick
Thinking kindly about other people
Frightened of being caught
Proud of being right

questions.q: What did Gub-Gub find on the island that made him squeak for joy?
choices: A whole valley full of wild sugarcane
A field of fat turnips by a little stream
A heap of apples under a tree
A wide, muddy pond to roll about in all day
questions.evidence: a whole valley full of wild sugarcane

questions.q: What did the two swallows come to tell the Doctor near the end of the chapter?
choices: The ship had already sunk down to the bottom of the bay
The canaries had found a better ship on the far shore of the island
The other swallows were rested and ready to fly on
The pirates were on his ship and had left theirs empty
questions.evidence: They have left their own ship with nobody on it
